reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the 'Every batch lab-tested' line on the front, because proof is the only thing that gets me to buy a supplement. I'd try one box of the plain bisglycinate, since one form is easier to judge than a blend, and I'd open the batch report before I ordered.
objection: Most supplements are marketing, and a QR code only helps if the report is real, names the lab and shows the actual magnesium number. Two capsules a day is also a lot of pill to swallow if they are big.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report turned out to be vague, missing, or not matched to my batch, I would not buy. If the capsules were tiny and easy to swallow, I would be more likely to reorder.
